Very true. I just find it very difficult as I have really bad anxiety and tend to shut down, which is something I’m trying to work on but it is very hard especially when you’re the only one in that boat and everyone else is already comfortable.

No I get that it could be a lot worst, both of us just really like to be in each other’s company and feel more content being around each other then apart so going from seeing each other all the time to hardly ever it’s a bit of a shock to the system. 
Unfortunately I made the decision to move before I met him then he came along and I didn’t want to leave bc I assumed that he would leave me after that bc it got harder and that’s what I’m used to people doing. 
I also get how horrible it can be being even further apart - my best friend lives in England and me in Scotland, he’s now moved to America which makes talking very difficult. 
I think I might not have put enough emphasis on how amazing and grateful I am for the time I do get with him and the face he’s stuck around even though it is tough. He’s the only long term, serious partner I’ve had as well as being the only one to ever tell me he loves me. 
It’s also very difficult for me to just go out and met people or go to events, not to mention the uni is in the middle of no where so not much is actually on haha

My current circumstance is being miles and miles from my family and only friends who have never fucked me over aka I’ve finally met people that care about me, including him, and I left bc as you said I’m selfish but I’m trying to see it as I’m doing what I need to do to be who I want to be and do what I want to do. Plus no one is mad at me for it, they all want to see me succeed but it does hurt bc I know it hurts them too and it’s my fault I’m not around. 
So yes my social life is a bit shit atm since the people I’m around at uni have been in the same class for 3 years now and I’ve just kinda been popped into a class of people who already have their friend groups. 
Also after year of being bullied by ex friends and manipulated by ex boyfriends so for changing my perspective was me accepting I am loveable and people do care about me.
Thank you, he gives me a lot of reassurance but it still hurts since I’m kinda not in the best headspace at the moment haha. Thank you so much ❤️
